rows.label: CRATER
rows.clue: A bowl-shaped geological formation at the top of a volcano

rows.label: PRECIPICE
rows.clue: A very steep cliff

rows.label: IRON FILING
rows.clue: A fragment of iron rubbed off by the use of a file

rows.label: SEAMOUNT
rows.clue: An underwater mountain rising above the ocean floor

rows.label: NUGGET
rows.clue: A solid lump of a precious metal (especially gold) as found in the earth

rows.label: UNIT CELL
rows.clue: The smallest group of atoms or molecules whose repetition at regular intervals in three dimensions produces the lattices of a crystal

rows.label: BRANCHED CHAIN
rows.clue: An open chain of atoms with one or more side chains attached to it

rows.label: ANTIPROTON
rows.clue: An unstable negatively charged proton

rows.label: SCREE
rows.clue: A sloping mass of loose rocks at the base of a cliff

rows.label: WATERFALL
rows.clue: A steep descent of the water of a river

rows.label: RADIO SOURCE
rows.clue: An object that radiates radio waves

rows.label: DELTA RAY
rows.clue: An electron ejected from matter by ionizing radiation

rows.label: CONTINENT
rows.clue: One of the large landmasses of the earth

rows.label: WATER HOLE
rows.clue: A natural hole or hollow containing water

rows.label: ICEBERG
rows.clue: A large mass of ice floating at sea

rows.label: SPOOR
rows.clue: The trail left by a person or an animal

rows.label: TIDEWAY
rows.clue: A channel in which a tidal current runs

rows.label: NEUTRON
rows.clue: An elementary particle with 0 charge and mass about equal to a proton

rows.label: FISHPOND
rows.clue: A freshwater pond with fish

rows.label: LITHOSPHERE
rows.clue: The solid part of the earth consisting of the crust and outer mantle

rows.label: BEDROCK
rows.clue: Solid unweathered rock lying beneath surface deposits of soil

rows.label: POTHOLE
rows.clue: A pit or hole produced by wear or weathering (especially in a road surface)

rows.label: GROTTO
rows.clue: A small cave (usually with attractive features)

rows.label: ESCARPMENT
rows.clue: A long steep slope or cliff at the edge of a plateau or ridge

rows.label: SIERRA
rows.clue: A range of mountains (usually with jagged peaks and irregular outline)

rows.label: WATER TABLE
rows.clue: Underground surface below which the ground is wholly saturated with water

rows.label: STRAIT
rows.clue: A narrow channel of the sea joining two larger bodies of water

rows.label: STRIP
rows.clue: A relatively long narrow piece of something

rows.label: HYDROSPHERE
rows.clue: The watery layer of the earth's surface

rows.label: FLARE STAR
rows.clue: A red dwarf star in which luminosity can change several magnitudes in a few minutes

rows.label: COSMIC STRING
rows.clue: (cosmology) a hypothetical one-dimensional subatomic particle having a concentration of energy and the dynamic properties of a flexible loop

rows.label: BELAY
rows.clue: Something to which a mountain climber's rope can be secured

rows.label: TRACK
rows.clue: A line or route along which something travels or moves

rows.label: CHASM
rows.clue: A deep opening in the earth's surface

rows.label: CANAL
rows.clue: (astronomy) an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels

rows.label: TIDAL BASIN
rows.clue: A basin that is full of water at high tide

rows.label: TIDEWATER
rows.clue: Low-lying coastal land drained by tidal streams

rows.label: CLIFF
rows.clue: A steep high face of rock

rows.label: ALPHA PARTICLE
rows.clue: A positively charged particle that is the nucleus of the helium atom

rows.label: TIDAL RIVER
rows.clue: A stream in which the effects of the tide extend far upstream

rows.label: GEYSER
rows.clue: A spring that discharges hot water and steam

rows.label: RETARDANT
rows.clue: Any agent that retards or delays or hinders

rows.label: WATER SYSTEM
rows.clue: A river and all of its tributaries

rows.label: SALT FLAT
rows.clue: A flat expanse of salt left by the evaporation of a body of salt water

rows.label: LAKEFRONT
rows.clue: Land bordering a lake

rows.label: HYDROGEN ION
rows.clue: A positively charged atom of hydrogen

rows.label: SCRAPING
rows.clue: (usually plural) a fragment scraped off of something and collected

rows.label: VARIABLE
rows.clue: Something that is likely to vary

rows.label: CHEMICAL CHAIN
rows.clue: (chemistry) a series of linked atoms (generally in an organic molecule)

rows.label: OZONE LAYER
rows.clue: A layer in the stratosphere (at approximately 20 miles) that contains a concentration of ozone sufficient to block most ultraviolet radiation from the sun

rows.label: STRETCH
rows.clue: A large and unbroken expanse or distance

rows.label: TAR PIT
rows.clue: A natural accumulation of bitumens at the surface of the earth

rows.label: LLANO
rows.clue: An extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain (especially in Latin America)

rows.label: BUILDING BLOCK
rows.clue: A single undivided natural thing occurring in the composition of something else

rows.label: HANGING WALL
rows.clue: The upper wall of an inclined fault

rows.label: HIGHLAND
rows.clue: Elevated (e.g., mountainous) land

rows.label: REMAINS
rows.clue: Any object that is left unused or still extant

rows.label: STRATOSPHERE
rows.clue: The atmospheric layer between the troposphere and the mesosphere

rows.label: INESSENTIAL
rows.clue: Anything that is not essential

rows.label: RIFT VALLEY
rows.clue: A valley with steep sides

rows.label: BARRIER REEF
rows.clue: A long coral reef near and parallel to the shore

rows.label: CORAL REEF
rows.clue: A reef consisting of coral consolidated into limestone

rows.label: LAGOON
rows.clue: A body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral

rows.label: SUPERNOVA
rows.clue: A star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process
